cause_quote: The diff removed `if (!thread.draft.trim())` and its `setDraft` call using `buildCompanionQuestionPrefill(attachment.selectionAnnotation.text) ?? ""`, leaving the question empty after a comment was saved.
user_saw: After saving a highlighted-text comment in Side chat, the user could send it only by typing a separate question.
summary: The fix supplies a default question when a saved selection comment is the only input, enabling both Ask and the keyboard shortcut.
reasoning: Before #180125, saving a comment into an empty Side chat composer inserted a short quote, and the previous browser test submitted that draft with the full selection and comment. #180125 removed the prefill while the question resolver still required draft text or an image, so saving a comment into an empty composer began disabling Ask.
